news.headline: Gold +1.3%, Silver +3.1% overnight
news.what_happened: Gold rose to ~$3,611/oz and silver jumped over 3% as US yields eased (10Y ~4.85%, -1.1%) and US equities slipped.
news.why_it_matters: Higher gold collateral values support gold-loan NBFCs; mild risk-off tone globally.

news.headline: Asia firm: Hang Seng +2.0%, Nikkei +1.6%
news.what_happened: Regional equities rallied strongly while Wall Street ended slightly lower (S&P -0.25%, Nasdaq -0.62%).
news.why_it_matters: Asian risk-on plus easing US yields supports Indian private banks with high FII ownership; FIIs have been net buyers through November.

news.headline: Monthly F&O expiry today
news.what_happened: Last Thursday of November: monthly derivatives expiry after Nifty's strong prior session (~25,819).
news.why_it_matters: Elevated intraday volatility and possible profit-booking; avoid aggressive entries at open.
